roots.rationale: Direct hasServingReport age checks and advanceMember held guard use synthetic OCI/host reports and map-backed state. No actual serving process,host API,OCI or durable store.
JSON round-trip and persist delegate to placementMemoryStore CAS. Preparation timestamp and pre-effect stage are local values; no disk/restart boundary.
Timeout outcome uses synthetic managedUpdateTestAuthority reads/commit callback and memory CAS. R3 wording instantiates no actual authority log/quorum; no host/status source.
Pure deadline predicate over supplied times,including equality,future clock and non-UTC input. No timer or service.
Profile validation and canonical digest of synthetic format/target pins. No retained filesystem,S3 target or Vault read.
Direct Validate table over locally generated/signed compatibility fixtures; no live admission,replication or persistent format qualification.
Direct Validate/Digest plus local VerifyEnvelope over generated key and fixed time. Local crypto is not admission transport or durable replay.
Synthetic authority history and map-backed CAS with injected conflict; a new Controller shares the same store/history. Repair/idempotence is local; no R3,disk or process restart.
Direct counters/gauge and WritePrometheus into bytes.Buffer. No HTTP scrape or external metrics persistence.

Summarize reads fake store slices/maps. Current body expects zero Serving and unknown readiness; baseline expected Serving=2. Both are unit; original obligation remains retained without transferred credit.
Direct state.Validate with mutated PreviousInstanceID/HostAttempt on synthetic state; no instance observation/persisted replacement.
Production failover adapter/state machine dispatches into reattachTestFleet maps/slices and fixed fake fencer/store. Third-attachment and unsupported holds have no real OCI/volume/journal.
Fake lifecycle/attachment/permit slices plus map CAS drive termination/detach/attach/mount sequence. Adapter reaches fakes; no provider request,filesystem mount or durable journal.
Lookup failures and epoch checks use fake lifecycle map/fixed fencer; current-epoch detach appends a fake request. No real authority loss or OCI execution.
Regions copies static founded catalog entries; mapping and rejection are local identity predicates. No cloud discovery.
Tick consumes synthetic lifecycle strings with fake clock/evidence callback and updates loss timestamps in memory. No OCI observation or durable loss record.
Direct replacement/retirement gate table uses observations,boolean safety claims and writer-stop byte strings. No independently acquired quorum,replication or fencing proof.
Tick sees fake fleet instances and empty fake host view; callback non-call/unchanged attempt are local. No real inventory/session.

Tick plus fabricated serving report,clock and evidence callback produces map-backed replacement state. Final assertions expect zero OCI Ensure/Terminate calls. No real grace wait,writer fencing or retained-volume transition.
Direct seat layout/ID functions over supplied domain strings and deterministic IDs; no actual OCI domains,placement engine or cluster.

func managedUpdateSeatMatches(seat ManagedUpdateSeat, state MemberState) bool {
	return seat.SeatID == state.MemberID && seat.Region == state.Region &&
		seat.MemberID == state.CanonicalRosterRow.MemberID && seat.Incarnation == state.CanonicalRosterRow.Incarnation &&
		seat.TLSLeafSHA256 == state.CanonicalRosterRow.TLSLeafSHA256 &&
		seat.RuntimeManifestDigest == state.RuntimeManifestDigest && seat.HostNode == state.HostNode &&
		seat.HostGeneration == state.HostGeneration && seat.HostAttempt == state.HostAttempt &&

		seat.VolumeID == state.VolumeID && seat.AttachmentID == state.AttachmentID &&

reported_serving.text:
func VerifyReportedServing(proof ServingProof, expected Identity, survivor Survivor) error {
	if !expected.Process.valid() || !expected.Scope.valid() || !expected.Authority.valid() ||
		!survivor.valid() || survivor.MemberID == expected.Scope.MemberID ||
		proof.SchemaVersion != 1 || proof.Process != expected.Process ||
		proof.Scope != expected.Scope || proof.Authority != expected.Authority ||
		!proof.Serving || !proof.Listeners.Client || !proof.Listeners.Replication ||
		!lowerHex(proof.Nonce, 32) || !lowerHex(proof.Object.RootSHA256, 64) ||
		!lowerHex(proof.Object.TargetSHA256, 64) ||
		!lowerHex(proof.Object.InboxArchiveSHA256AtRecovery, 64) ||
		proof.Object.RemoteAppliedSequence > proof.Object.RemoteInboxDurableSequence ||
		proof.Replication.PeerMemberID != survivor.MemberID ||
		proof.Replication.PeerIncarnation != survivor.Incarnation ||
		!proof.Replication.CurrentAuthenticated ||
		proof.Replication.LocalSourceSequence != proof.Object.LocalSourceSequence ||
		proof.Replication.PeerAppliedSequence < proof.Replication.LocalSourceSequence ||
		!proof.Replication.ordered() {
		return ErrNotServing
	}
	return nil
}

serving_prefixes.text:
func (r ReplicationProof) ordered() bool {
	return (r.PeerReceivedSequence == nil) == (r.LocalInboxReceivedSequence == nil) &&
		r.PeerAppliedSequence <= r.PeerDurableSequence &&
		(r.PeerReceivedSequence == nil || r.PeerDurableSequence <= *r.PeerReceivedSequence) &&
		r.LocalInboxAppliedSequence <= r.LocalInboxDurableSequence &&
		(r.LocalInboxReceivedSequence == nil || r.LocalInboxDurableSequence <= *r.LocalInboxReceivedSequence)
}
